question.text: Which of the following properties will change when system containing solution 1 will become solution 2?

solution.text: Both solutions are having same composition, which is 1 mole of ' $x$ ' in 1 ' $\ell$ ' water, so all the intensive properties will remain same, but as total amount is greater in solution ' 1 ' compared to solution ' 2 '. So extensive properties will be different hence Gibbs free energy will be different.
